ai.seo_question: Who is Muhammad ibn Nasir al-Namiri in the context of Shia history?
ai.summary: Muhammad ibn Nasir al-Namiri is identified among the prominent figures who asserted exclusive deputyship during the Minor Occultation, a claim that drew scrutiny from the Imams to distinguish true representatives from self-proclaimed authorities. His inclusion in this chapter highlights the critical Shia scholarly effort to validate the chain of authority and prevent confusion among the faithful regarding legitimate leadership during the Imam's absence.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: And among them Muhammad Ibn Nasir Numairi:
